lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The neon sign flickers a soft shade of blue
My coffee is cooling, my thoughts turn to you
The city is dreaming while I wait for the cue
[chorus]
Midnight velvet, smooth and slow
Just the shadows moving, watching the tempo grow
In this quiet corner where the secrets go
[verse]
A saxophone whispers a tune in the hall
The moon paints a picture against the brick wall
Nothing else matters, no worries at all
[chorus]
Midnight velvet, smooth and slow
Just the shadows moving, watching the tempo grow
In this quiet corner where the secrets go
[bridge]
Time starts to loosen its hold on the room
Chasing the embers in the low-light gloom
Lost in the rhythm of a flower in bloom
[chorus]
Midnight velvet, smooth and slow
Just the shadows moving, watching the tempo grow
In this quiet corner where the secrets go
[outro]
